name: Fuzzy Repaired Word Count Step
overview: Counts the words in text units whose top alternate translation is a `FUZZY_REPAIRED` match — a fuzzy (partial) match of text and/or codes to which some automated repair was then applied to the target, such as number replacement, code repair, capitalization, or punctuation adjustment. The count is recorded as a word-count metric in a `MetricsAnnotation` so that scoping and pricing steps can separate auto-repaired fuzzy leverage from raw fuzzy matches that received no post-processing.
processingNotes: Operates per segment: it inspects the first (top-ranked) `AltTranslation` on each target segment's `AltTranslationsAnnotation` and counts a segment only when that match type is exactly `FUZZY_REPAIRED`.
Counting is performed on the **source** text, not the target — the word total reflects the source volume leveraged at this match level.
Words are counted with the GMX-V word counter; the parallel character-count variant counts characters instead.
Counts only translatable text units; empty text units and non-translatable ones are skipped.

Results are stored as annotations on filter events and aggregated to the configured levels (text unit, group, document, sub-document, batch item, batch); the step produces no output document of its own.

Belongs to the `OKAPI_WORD_COUNTS` category group. The `CategoryResolver` keeps only the highest-ranked matching category per segment — `FUZZY_REPAIRED` ranks below plain `FUZZY` and above `PHRASE_ASSEMBLED`, `MT`, and `CONCORDANCE`.
